question: 202609 기준 마케팅캠페인명별 배분 추정 회비 상위 5개와 배분 불가 금액
result:

Generated SQL (ensure the -- Generated by Cortex Analyst comment is included when executing the SQL):
```sql
WITH base AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM SEMANTIC_VIEW(
        GN_DW.SERVING.SV_ML_FEE_FORECAST_AXIS
        METRICS total_alloc_forecast_fee
        DIMENSIONS fx.stdr_mt, fx.is_allocated, fx.mktg_cmpgn_nm
        WHERE fx.stdr_mt = '202609'
    )
),
allocated AS (
    SELECT
        mktg_cmpgn_nm,
        ROUND(total_alloc_forecast_fee) AS alloc_amt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_alloc_forecast_fee DESC NULLS LAST) AS rnk
    FROM base
    WHERE is_allocated = TRUE
),
top5 AS (
    SELECT
        rnk,
        mktg_cmpgn_nm,
        alloc_amt
    FROM allocated
    WHERE rnk <= 5
),
unallocated AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(ROUND(total_alloc_forecast_fee)) AS unalloc_amt
    FROM base
    WHERE is_allocated = FALSE
)
SELECT
    t.rnk                          AS "순위",
    t.mktg_cmpgn_nm                AS "마케팅캠페인명",
    t.alloc_amt                    AS "배분 추정 회비(원)"
FROM top5 t
UNION ALL
SELECT
    NULL                           AS "순위",
    '배분 불가(실적 비중 없음)'         AS "마케팅캠페인명",
    u.unalloc_amt                  AS "배분 추정 회비(원)"
FROM unallocated u
ORDER BY "순위" ASC NULLS LAST
 -- Generated by Cortex Analyst (request_id: 6f2d196d-120d-484d-b8f3-5f6fe055e00e)
;
```
